# Data to Darwin Core

This script converts data to DarwinCore format.

## Required packages

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
library(writexl)
library(readr)
library(lubridate)
library(readr)
library(stringr)
library(data.table)
library(kableExtra)
library(tidyr)
library(forcats)
library(here)
library(openxlsx)
```

## Import data

```{r}

df <- readxl::read_excel(here::here("Data", 
"Herminium_monorchis_masterfile_v_2026.xlsx"), sheet= "Plot_herminium")    
#subsetting 2026-data
df <- df %>%
  filter(Year == 2026)

## Import dataset on environmental variables for MeasurementOrFact sheet
df2 <-readxl::read_excel(here::here("Data", 
"Herminium_monorchis_masterfile_v_2026.xlsx"),sheet= "Plot_environment")                            
df2 <- df2 %>%
  filter(Year == 2026)

## import dataset for making Events, including observer, date etc
df3 <-readxl::read_excel(here::here("Data", "Herminium_monorchis_masterfile_v_2026.xlsx"), sheet= "Plot_General")

```

## Load data template

```{r}
# What the data should look like
occ = read_excel(here::here("Data", "Herminium_Monitoring_NINA_EventCore_importskjema_2025.xlsx"),
                 sheet = "Occurrence")

event = read_excel(here::here("Data", "Herminium_Monitoring_NINA_EventCore_importskjema_2025.xlsx"), 
                 sheet = "Event")

event <- event %>%
  filter(year == 2025)
event <- event %>%
  rename(Plot_ID_new = locationID)

measOrFact = read_excel(here::here("Data", "Herminium_Monitoring_NINA_EventCore_importskjema_2025.xlsx"),  
                 sheet = "MeasurementOrFact")

```

## Creating DwC file

```{r}
#Create eventID
df3 = df3 %>% 
  mutate(eventID = paste("NINA.Herminium.Monitoring",Locality, Year, Plot_ID_new, sep = "."), parentEventID = paste("NINA.Herminium.Monitoring",Locality, Year, sep="."))

# linking general info with Hm info, for easy making of occurrence table
df_joined <- df %>%
  left_join(df3, by = "Plot_ID_new")

## Create occurrence table
hbOcc2026 <- df_joined %>%
  transmute(
    eventID = eventID,
    basisOfRecord = "HumanObservation",
    occurrenceRemarks = "",
    recordNumber = "",
    recordedBy = Observer,
    individualCount = Herminium_count_total,
    organismQuantity = "",
    sex = "",
    
    lifeStage = if_else(
      Herminium_count_total == 0,
      "",
      paste(
        Herminium_count_fertile, "fertile",
        Herminium_count_vegetative, "vegetative"
      ),
      missing = ""
    ),
    
    establishmentMeans = "",
    
    occurrenceStatus = if_else(
      Herminium_count_total == 0,
      "absent",
      "present",
      missing = ""
    ),
    
    preparations = "",
    organismRemarks = "",
    identifiedBy = "",
    identificationRemarks = "",
    typeStatus = "",
    identificationQualifier = "",
    scientificName = "Herminium monorchis",
    LatinskNavnID = "99524",
    kingdom = "Plantae",
    phylum = "Magnoliophyta",
    class = "Monocots",
    order = "Asparagales",
    family = "Orchidaceae",
    genus = "Herminium",
    specificEpithet = "monorchis",
    subspecies = "",
    scientificNameAuthorship = "(L.) R.Br.",
    vernacularName = "honningblom",
    taxonRemarks = "HumanObservation"
  )



# linking general info with environment info, for easy making of occurrence table
df_joined2 <- df2 %>%
  left_join(df3, by = "Plot_ID_new")

hbMoF2026 <- df_joined2 %>%
  select(
    eventID,
    Observer,
    Date,
    Vegetation_height_mean,
    Fieldlayer_cover,
    Groundlayer_cover,
    Litter_cover
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      Vegetation_height_mean,
      Fieldlayer_cover,
      Groundlayer_cover,
      Litter_cover
    ),
    names_to = "source_variable",
    values_to = "measurementValue"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(measurementValue)) %>%
  mutate(
    measurementType = recode(
      source_variable,
      Vegetation_height_mean = "Vegetation.height",
      Fieldlayer_cover = "Field.layer",
      Groundlayer_cover = "Bottom.layer",
      Litter_cover = "Litter"
    ),
    measurementID = "",
    measurementAccuracy = "",
    measurementUnit = case_when(
      measurementType == "Vegetation.height" ~ "cm",
      TRUE ~ "%"
    ),
    measurementDeterminedBy = Observer,
    measurementDeterminedDate = Date,
    measurementMethod = "Visual estimate",
    measurementRemarks = "Sampling protocol and variables described in Roos et al. 2024"
  ) %>%
  select(
    eventID,
    measurementID,
    measurementType,
    measurementValue,
    measurementAccuracy,
    measurementUnit,
    measurementDeterminedBy,
    measurementDeterminedDate,
    measurementMethod,
    measurementRemarks
  )

## Making event table

# Oppslagstabell med informasjon fra tidligere Event-data
event_lookup <- event %>%
  select(
    Plot_ID_new,
    habitat,
    habitatNiN,
    versionNiN,
    UTMsone,
    UTMnord,
    UTMost,
    coordinateUncertaintyInMeters
  ) %>%
  distinct(Plot_ID_new, .keep_all = TRUE)


# Én Event-rad per prøveflate
plot_events <- df_joined2 %>%
  left_join(
    event_lookup,
    by = "Plot_ID_new"
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    # Metadata
    type = "",
    license = "",
    datasetName = "Herminium monorchis_monitoring",
    ownerInstitutionCode = "Norwegian Institute for Nature Research",
    informationWithheld = "",
    dataGeneralizations = "",
    dynamicProperties = "",
    ansvarligNINA = "Marianne Evju",
    
    # Event
    eventID = eventID,
    parentEventID = parentEventID,
    
    samplingProtocol = paste(
      "Recording of number of ramets of H. monorchis,",
      "counted separately for vegetative and fertile ramets,",
      "vegetation cover and height, in permanently marked plots.",
      "For details, see Roos et al. (2024)."
    ),
    
    sampleSizeValue = 0.25,
    sampleSizeUnit = "square metre",
    samplingEffort = "",
    
    eventDate = format(Date, "%Y-%m-%d"),
    eventTime = "",
    year = Year.x,
    month = month,
    day = day,
    
    habitat = habitat,
    habitatNiN = habitatNiN,
    versionNiN = versionNiN,
    
    fieldNumber = "",
    fieldNotes = "",
    eventRemarks = "",
    
    # Location
    locationID = Plot_ID_new,
    country = "Norway",
    stateProvince = "Østfold",
    county = "Hvaler",
    locality = Locality.x,
    
    longitude = "",
    latitude = "",
    originalkoordinat_longitude = "",
    originalkoordinat_latitude = "",
    
    UTMsone = UTMsone,
    UTMost = UTMost,
    UTMnord = UTMnord,
    
    footprintWKT = "",
    coordinateUncertaintyInMeters = coordinateUncertaintyInMeters,
    coordinatePrecision = "",
    
    minimumElevationInMeters = "",
    maximumElevationInMeters = "",
    minimumDepthInMeters = "",
    maximumDepthInMeters = "",
    locationAccordingTo = ""
  ) %>%
  distinct(eventID, .keep_all = TRUE)

parent_events <- df_joined2 %>%
  distinct(parentEventID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  transmute(
    # Metadata
    type = "",
    license = "",
    datasetName = "Herminium monorchis_monitoring",
    ownerInstitutionCode = "Norwegian Institute for Nature Research",
    informationWithheld = "",
    dataGeneralizations = "",
    dynamicProperties = "",
    ansvarligNINA = "Marianne Evju",
    
    # Event
    eventID = parentEventID,
    parentEventID = NA_character_,
    
    samplingProtocol = "",
    sampleSizeValue = NA_real_,
    sampleSizeUnit = "",
    samplingEffort = "",
    
    eventDate = format(Date, "%Y-%m-%d"),
    eventTime = "",
    year = Year.x,
    month = month,
    day = day,
    
    habitat = "",
    habitatNiN = "",
    versionNiN = "",
    
    fieldNumber = "",
    fieldNotes = "",
    eventRemarks = "",
    
    # Location
    locationID = "",
    country = "Norway",
    stateProvince = "Østfold",
    county = "Hvaler",
    locality = Locality.x,
    
    longitude = "",
    latitude = "",
    originalkoordinat_longitude = "",
    originalkoordinat_latitude = "",
    
    UTMsone = NA,
    UTMost = NA_real_,
    UTMnord = NA_real_,
    
    footprintWKT = "",
    coordinateUncertaintyInMeters = NA_real_,
    coordinatePrecision = "",
    
    minimumElevationInMeters = "",
    maximumElevationInMeters = "",
    minimumDepthInMeters = "",
    maximumDepthInMeters = "",
    locationAccordingTo = ""
  )


Event2026 <- bind_rows(
  parent_events,
  plot_events
)
```

## Create and output excel file

```{r}

wb <- createWorkbook()

addWorksheet(wb, "Event")
writeData(wb, "Event", Event2026)

addWorksheet(wb, "Occurrence")
writeData(wb, "Occurrence", hbOcc2026)

addWorksheet(wb,"MeasurementOrFact")
writeData(wb,"MeasurementOrFact",hbMoF2026)

saveWorkbook(wb, here::here("Data", 
                            "Herminium_Monitoring_NINA_EventCore_2026.xlsx"), overwrite = TRUE)


```
